description: Triggers for finishing a development branch (pre-ship checklist, opening the PR with evidence, merge / keep / discard), writing release notes and the runbook, checking docs drift and handing a release over to Operate

queries.query: All tasks are done and the DoD is green — open the pull request with the evidence
I'm finished with this branch, what are my options: merge, PR, keep it or throw it away?
Write the PR description with before/after screenshots and whether this is a one-way door
Delete the experiment branch and its worktree, we are not shipping it
PR #138 is merged, prepare the release notes for v2.14.0
Write the runbook for the new export endpoint and alert before we release
Which docs does this diff make stale? Check API reference and migration guide drift before shipping
Run the pre-ship checklist on feature/csv-export before I ask for review
Release is at 100% and stable, hand it over to the SRE with the production links
Fill in the 'For users' section and the CHANGELOG entry for this release
Test sign-off is in, merge the branch and clean up the worktree
Set up branch protection and the production environment reviewers in CI
Review this PR across correctness, security and design and triage the findings
Are these test results fresh? Check the Verification rows against the current fingerprint
The export error alert fired in production, start the incident and write the postmortem
Execute the next task in plan.md test-first
Run the retrospective for the CSV export release
Configure a canary deployment pipeline with automatic rollback thresholds
Convert this release notes Markdown file into a PDF
